# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Reader = azure/gpt-5.5, tier STRONG-but-not-frontier → explicit imperative rules + one anchored
worked cue for the tricky type/format case; no over-constraining ALL-CAPS.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | VALUE/logic wrong (capability ceiling) | 53367,5192,56996,57090,59743,11842,50051,325-44,450-9,110-2,39046,3911(part),56637(part) | genuine reasoning / reshape / macro-emulation / ambiguous-filter errors | CAPABILITY-GAP | mostly skipped (prose can't encode task logic); only 50051/3911 addressed via compute-from-data |
| 2 | Anchoring to copy-1 pre-filled example/summary/spill cells | 3911, 38332 | agent HAD correct computation, abandoned it to defer to a copy-1 counts table / spilled UNIQUE column | KNOWLEDGE | missing-rule (prompt.md) |
| 3 | Generalize to hidden copies (extent/boundary/threshold) | 50051, 56427, 59259 | hardcoded copy-1 row count / segment-start marker / calendar-year assumption | KNOWLEDGE | missing-rule (prompt.md + template) |
| 4 | TYPE / format mismatch | 50630, 57232, 59259, 51958 | wrote datetime where text expected; wrote 0/float where #N/A/"-"/float expected | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT | contract + worked-cue (template) |
| 5 | COVERAGE / over-production | CF_11072, 56637, 110-2, 55931 | left target cells unfilled; or overwrote values on a formatting task | CONTRACT | contract + structural verify step (template) |
| — | Benchmark NOISE (not fixable) | 30709, 51359 | 30709 agent logic == GT on all copies (LibreOffice recalc/locale artifact); 51359 input≠answer data (corruption) | ENVIRONMENT/NOISE | SKIPPED (handed back) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | missing-rule | prompt.md | "re-run on other copies → compute extent/boundaries/thresholds from data; never hardcode row count/position/boundary/year seen only in preview" | BOUNDED; 59667/58109 already compute dynamically |
| 2 | missing-rule | prompt.md | "pre-filled worked example/summary/spill cells reflect copy 1 only → learn format from them but recompute every value from raw source" | BOUNDED; recompute-from-source = same result on copy tasks |
| 3 | contract | task_template.md | grading facts: re-run on 3 copies, value AND type compared, write verbatim paths, may inspect all copies in early turn | BOUNDED; restates true contract passing tasks already meet |
| 4 | contract + worked cue | task_template.md | match expected TYPE: replicate worked-example cell's per-column type/format + preserve spaces; instruction-named literals (#N/A, "-"); preserve rich-text/formatting, never flatten | BOUNDED; reinforces no-strip + rich-text (protects 73-45) |
| 5 | contract | task_template.md | fill only requested cells (no extra labels/totals); formatting/CF tasks keep values & formulas, modify only formatting | BOUNDED; CF passing tasks already keep values |
| 5 | structural verify | task_template.md | step 3: print value AND type per cell; confirm required cells filled, no unintended None, special types kept | BOUNDED; stronger precondition, no new demand on passing tasks |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 3911: seed's FIRST code was the correct greedy denomination breakdown (==GT), then it over-engineered to fit copy-1's pre-filled COUNT table → broke copy1. prompt.md rule "don't let pre-filled summary cells constrain you; recompute from source" keeps the greedy solution. (Cluster 2)
- 38332: seed's first attempt was `COUNTIF(A,C)>0` (==GT) but a spilled UNIQUE helper read as a formula object, so it switched to a copy-1-only heuristic. Rule "recompute dynamic-array helper values yourself; don't trust the spill cell" keeps the correct COUNTIF logic. (Cluster 2)
- 50051: seed scanned column T to a hardcoded row 600, pulling extraneous numbers → 0/3. "detect real data extent, never hardcode row counts" makes it scan to the true last row. (Cluster 3)
- 59259: instruction says "output result may be '-'"; seed wrote numeric 0 → copy2 fail. "instruction-named literal → write that literal not 0" reproduces GT's dash. (Cluster 4)
- 57232: instruction says result "may be #N/A"; seed wrote 0.0 (float) for no-match → 0/3 with "float where str expected". Instruction-named-literal rule writes #N/A. (Cluster 4)
- 50630: split-text task; answer range CONTAINS worked-example row5 (C=text, D='8 Sep 2021 ' TEXT with trailing \xa0, E=real datetime). Seed parsed D into datetime → "datetime where str expected". "replicate the worked-example cell's exact per-column type/format, preserve trailing spaces" makes it keep D as text. (Cluster 4)
- CF_11072: conditional-formatting task; seed overwrote/cleared values (18/20 filled). "for formatting/CF tasks keep existing values & formulas, modify only formatting" preserves all 20. (Cluster 5)
- 56637 / 110-2 (partial): step-3 coverage check ("no cell you meant to fill is unexpectedly None") nudges a rethink when a fill leaves target cells blank. (Cluster 5, low confidence)

## Blast-radius per edit (SAFE test)
All six edits are BOUNDED-ADDITIVE (a new predicate or a contract clarification passing tasks
already satisfy). None loosens/broadens a global decision or refusal rule. Passing-class check:
- Type/format edit: the 26 passing tasks already emit matching types & preserve formatting; the
  rich-text/formatting-preserve clause is the OPPOSITE of what broke 73-45, so it protects it.
- Fill-only/formatting-keep: passing CF/Sheet tasks (160-6, 575-16, 448-11, 185-13, 353-29…)
  already keep values and touch only the requested range.
- Compute-from-data / don't-trust-example: passing tasks (59667, 58109, 44266…) already compute
  from raw source; recomputing a value that equals a pre-filled cell yields the same value, so no
  passing trajectory flips.

## What I DROPPED from cand_0001 (it was net-zero: fixed {50051,59259,CF_11072}, broke {56975,59667,73-45})
Isolated by subagent + independent trace read:
- Block F "a text answer must be a str … type mismatch = grader rejects" → flattened CellRichText
  on 73-45. DROPPED; replaced with explicit "rich-text/formatting cells keep their special type".
- Block D "keep extracted text as text / text compared exactly" → same rich-text flatten risk.
  DROPPED; type fidelity now anchored to the observable worked-example cell, not a blanket.
- Block E clauses 3–4 "take the simplest reading … do not replace with a more elaborate
  computation during verification" → pushed agent off the required non-obvious computation, broke
  59667 (blank-C rows need extrapolated NUMBERS, not blanks) and 56975. DROPPED entirely.
- cand_0001's blanket "leave a cell empty rather than a 0 placeholder" → replaced by the narrower
  instruction-named-literal rule (only fires when the instruction names #N/A / "-").
Re-shipped only the parts that fixed a task with no break: compute-from-data (A), hidden-copy
contract (C), fill-only + formatting-keep-values (E1/E2). Added the NEW Cluster-2 rule (pre-filled
example/summary/spill cells) that cand_0001 lacked.

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel general-purpose subagents: (1) isolate which cand_0001 block fixed/broke each of the
  6 tasks, (2) diagnose the 7 partial-pass hidden-copy tasks, (3) diagnose the 16 full-fail tasks.
  I independently cross-checked traces 59667, 56975, 50630, 57232, 50051, CF_11072 myself.
- Read: LEDGER, JOURNAL (cand_0001 RESULT), RUNMAP, prior_iterations/cand_0001/diff.patch+PROCESS,
  system-prompt SKILL + concepts, MEMORY.md regression traps.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo)
- Never re-add the "text answer must be str" / "keep extracted text as text" framing → flattens
  rich text (73-45). Anchor type to the worked-example cell instead.
- Never re-add "simplest reading / don't elaborate during verification" → broke 59667, 56975.
- Keep formula/XML guidance and no-blanket-strip verbatim (recorded regression traps).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Cluster 1 VALUE/logic ceiling (53367, 5192, 56996, 57090, 59743, 11842, 325-44, 450-9, 110-2 filter
  logic, 39046 ambiguity, 55931 row-alignment): genuine computation errors; no general prose rule
  can encode task-specific logic without leaking answers. Prose won't move a hard zero here.
- NOISE (30709 recalc/locale artifact, 51359 corrupted input≠answer): not prompt-fixable; handed back.
